description: This PHP class, named EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator, acts as a decorator for the EmployeeTerminationRecord entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides additional methods for formatting the termination date and setting the termination reason via an ID, encapsulating common behaviors related to employee termination records.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationRecordDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for EmployeeTerminationRecord entity, providing additional methods for date formatting and setting termination reasons.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeTerminationRecord object.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted termination date as a string, or null if no date is set.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Sets the termination reason for the employee termination record based on the provided termination reason ID.
